events.title: Over The Gnome! 1.4
events.summary: ❤️ Health & HeartsYou can now take damage! Getting hit by a gnome, a vortex or a snowball costs a heart.Your hearts appear in the top-right and pulse gently.After a hit you're briefly invulnerable and blink red, so a whole crowd can't take you down instantly.Lose all your hearts and it's over — you'll Prestige automatically.Prefer a chill run? Toggle Easy Mode in the main menu to play without health.Down to your last heart? The music turns tense until you heal back up.⚡ New Prestige UpgradesVita
